item.title: What NBA star Steph Curry said about the Sundance Film Festival and his movie’s award
item.description: NBA star Stephen Curry couldn't make it to Park City during his two nights in Utah this week, but he still found a way to make an acceptance speech.

item.title: The Utah Utes’ new ballpark is a college baseball ‘Disneyland’
item.description: After years of playing at Smith's Ballpark, the University of Utah has its own baseball stadium on campus.

item.title: Wasatch Front, southern Utah cities are still the fastest growing. See how your hometown compares.
item.description: Utah's cities, towns and metro townships added about 59,000 people in 2024, according to the latest American Community Survey estimates.

item.title: An NBA star, in town to play the Jazz, just won a top award at the Sundance Film Festival
item.description: Basketball star Stephen Curry can add another trophy to his wall: Best short film at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.

item.title: Letter: Trump is coming for Grand Staircase-Escalante. Keeping public lands public requires action — now.
item.description: Letter: Trump is coming for Grand Staircase-Escalante, with the full support of Utah’s congressional delegation. We must bombard their offices with calls to stop this.

item.title: Letter: We have a responsibility to defend the values that make America worth fighting for. Outrage is not enough.
item.description: Letter: The rights upon which this nation was built are under assault from the Trump administration. Being outraged about it is not enough. We must all act. Our future depends on it.

item.title: Bagley Cartoon: Tough Snowflakes
item.description: Check out Pat Bagley's latest cartoon: Tough Snowflakes

item.title: As Utah looks to cut schools budget, one lawmaker chides an arts group for LGBTQ advocacy
item.description: A West Valley City lawmaker is scrutinizing a state program that gives nonprofits money to put arts programs in schools — because one has held LGBTQ-friendly events at its headquarters.

item.title: Man who falsely claimed he killed Charlie Kirk, diverting police amid chaos, sentenced to prison
item.description: George Zinn began to cry while reading his statement to the court at his sentencing Thursday. Prosecutors said his false confession diverted law enforcement during the chaotic moments after Charlie Kirk was killed.

item.title: Utah’s Sens. Lee and Curtis split on DHS vote — but not on Homeland Security funding
item.description: Utah's Sens. Mike Lee and John Curtis split their votes on a controversial DHS spending package. Here's why.
